billed_as: IMTIAZ VIRTUAL - explore all our locations and projects virtually in 3D with walkthrough option. A new way to showcase Imtiaz Developments to your clients.
verdict: DEMO. The site carries its own DEMO badge and none of the inventory is real.
evidence: A badge reading DEMO sits beside the project count on the interactive map.
34 projects across 6 cities including Riyadh, Jeddah and Doha. Imtiaz builds in Dubai.
None of the eight project names on the map appear in Imtiaz's real portfolio: Ewan Residence, Roya Gardens, Sedra Vista, Manara Tower, Yasmin Park, Areen Court, Nawar Heights, Saffron Bay.
Real Imtiaz projects on record: Cove, Pearl House, Westwood, Raw District, Symphony, Seacliff, Wynwood, Sunset Bay, The Archive, Hyde Walk, ENRE.
The eight names repeat across markers with different unit counts and prices. Unit counts alternate between 16 and 32.
The root URL has no route at all; only /interactive-map, /tour, /floorplate, /abu-dhabi, /yas-island and /zoomable-map resolve.
The page opens a websocket to backoffice.server.virtualvisions.studio and registers a visitor profile, so every broker who opens it is tracked by the vendor.
so_what: This is a vendor's product demonstration built under an Imtiaz-branded subdomain, not a catalogue of Imtiaz stock. A broker showing it to a client would be quoting projects that do not exist. Nothing from it belongs in the truth store.
